fields.Name: T166 - Entity Form View Membership
fields.Description: Verifies a Membership record can be opened from the grid into its full record form with populated detail fields.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Memberships' entity via the left sidebar 'Search entities...' box: click the search box, type 'Memberships', then click the exact 'Memberships' node in the results (do NOT expand the entity group/chevron). When the grid loads, click a row, then click the 'Open Full Record' button. Verify the full record form displays with populated detail fields. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait patiently, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Membership full record form is open (not just the grid/preview panel)
The form shows populated detail fields for the membership record
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
